usageNote: 名词短语，"the number of"后接复数名词但动词用单数，跟"a number of"（许多）别搞混哦！

examples.en: The number of people in the world has exceeded 8 billion.
examples.zh: 世界上的人口数量已超过80亿。

examples.en: Scientists are concerned about the rapid growth in the number of people in the world.
examples.zh: 科学家们对全球人口数量的快速增长感到担忧。
